requirement_text: To meet the general entry requirements for bachelor's studies, you must: have successfully completed your upper secondary (high school) education (post-16), and be able to demonstrate proficiency in English.
source_authority_note: universityadmissions.se is the official national admissions operator for Swedish higher education, run jointly by the Swedish Council for Higher Education (UHR) and the universities; it is not a .edu/.ac./.gov domain. Needs the APPLICATION_SYSTEM_DOMAINS tier from source-authority-gap.md piece (B), under which it is HIGH authority for platform-wide deadlines, fee structure and central eligibility assessment, and NOT authoritative for programme-specific thresholds.
researcher_notes: General entry requirement, set nationally and assessed centrally by University Admissions rather than by the individual university.

requirement_text: For applicants who received their final school grades after 31 December 2009, there is an additional mathematics requirement. You must have successfully completed courses equivalent to the Swedish courses Mathematics 1a, 1b or 1c/Mathematics Level 1a, 1b or 1c.
source_authority_note: universityadmissions.se is the official national admissions operator for Swedish higher education, run jointly by the Swedish Council for Higher Education (UHR) and the universities; it is not a .edu/.ac./.gov domain. Needs the APPLICATION_SYSTEM_DOMAINS tier from source-authority-gap.md piece (B), under which it is HIGH authority for platform-wide deadlines, fee structure and central eligibility assessment, and NOT authoritative for programme-specific thresholds.
limitations: Conditional on the date the applicant's final school grades were issued (after 31 December 2009), not on the entry cycle. An evaluator with no qualification-date fact on the student cannot decide whether this rule applies.
researcher_notes: A cohort-scoped requirement -- the third distinct shape after recency rules and named exclusions. Unlike a recency rule it never expires; it switches on permanently for everyone graduating after a fixed calendar date.

requirement_text: For courses and programmes at the bachelor's level, the general entry requirement for English is studies equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6/English Level 2.
source_authority_note: universityadmissions.se is the official national admissions operator for Swedish higher education, run jointly by the Swedish Council for Higher Education (UHR) and the universities; it is not a .edu/.ac./.gov domain. Needs the APPLICATION_SYSTEM_DOMAINS tier from source-authority-gap.md piece (B), under which it is HIGH authority for platform-wide deadlines, fee structure and central eligibility assessment, and NOT authoritative for programme-specific thresholds.
researcher_notes: The Swedish system expresses the English requirement as a course level, not a test score; test scores below are equivalences to that level, not the requirement itself.

requirement_text: For English 6/English Level 2*: an overall score of 6.5 and no section below 5.5
source_authority_note: universityadmissions.se is the official national admissions operator for Swedish higher education, run jointly by the Swedish Council for Higher Education (UHR) and the universities; it is not a .edu/.ac./.gov domain. Needs the APPLICATION_SYSTEM_DOMAINS tier from source-authority-gap.md piece (B), under which it is HIGH authority for platform-wide deadlines, fee structure and central eligibility assessment, and NOT authoritative for programme-specific thresholds.
researcher_notes: IELTS equivalence to English 6. IELTS is on an unchanged 0-9 band scale, so no scale ambiguity applies.

requirement_text: We only accept IELTS Academic, IELTS Online, IELTS UKVI (Academic) and IELTS One Skill Retake (Academic). Please note that we do not accept IELTS General Training or IELTS Indicator.
source_authority_note: universityadmissions.se is the official national admissions operator for Swedish higher education, run jointly by the Swedish Council for Higher Education (UHR) and the universities; it is not a .edu/.ac./.gov domain. Needs the APPLICATION_SYSTEM_DOMAINS tier from source-authority-gap.md piece (B), under which it is HIGH authority for platform-wide deadlines, fee structure and central eligibility assessment, and NOT authoritative for programme-specific thresholds.
limitations: Named provenance rule. Sweden ACCEPTS IELTS One Skill Retake; the University of Edinburgh explicitly rejects it (see scalar-thresholds-are-not-enough.md section 3) and DTU rejects it too (REQ-2026-08-22-DK-DTU). A numerically identical band is admissible at one institution and inadmissible at another, so a threshold comparison alone cannot decide this.
researcher_notes: This is the positive case for the excluded-provenance field: the list of accepted variants is as load-bearing as the number.

requirement_text: For test results 21 January 2026 and later -- For English 6/English Level 2*: Total score of 4.5 (scale 1-6) with no section less than 4
source_authority_note: universityadmissions.se is the official national admissions operator for Swedish higher education, run jointly by the Swedish Council for Higher Education (UHR) and the universities; it is not a .edu/.ac./.gov domain. Needs the APPLICATION_SYSTEM_DOMAINS tier from source-authority-gap.md piece (B), under which it is HIGH authority for platform-wide deadlines, fee structure and central eligibility assessment, and NOT authoritative for programme-specific thresholds.
researcher_notes: Exemplary handling of the ETS rescale: the threshold is bound to an explicit date range AND names its own scale inline ('scale 1-6'). Both the overall and the section minimum are on the post-cutover scale, so the requirement is fully satisfiable by a score report issued in the range it governs -- unlike Glasgow's and Bogazici's rows in scalar-thresholds-are-not-enough.md.

requirement_text: For test results 20 January 2026 and earlier -- For English 6/English Level 2*: Score of 20 (scale 0-30) in written test, total score of 90
source_authority_note: universityadmissions.se is the official national admissions operator for Swedish higher education, run jointly by the Swedish Council for Higher Education (UHR) and the universities; it is not a .edu/.ac./.gov domain. Needs the APPLICATION_SYSTEM_DOMAINS tier from source-authority-gap.md piece (B), under which it is HIGH authority for platform-wide deadlines, fee structure and central eligibility assessment, and NOT authoritative for programme-specific thresholds.
limitations: Upper-bounded to score reports issued 20 January 2026 or earlier, so the 0-30 subtest figure is measurable for every report it governs. Read together with the post-cutover row this is a complete, non-overlapping pair.
researcher_notes: The counterexample that proves the scale qualifier is achievable in practice: the same operator publishes both scales, each bounded to the dates it applies to. Contrast Lund's page, which carries only this legacy row with no date bound at all.

requirement_text: We accept the TOEFL iBT, TOEFL iBT Home Edition and TOEFL iBT Paper Edition. Please note that we do not accept TOEFL ITP, TOEFL iBT MyBest, Institutional TOEFL, TOEFL Essentials, or the revised TOEFL Paper-delivered Test (available 2017-2021).

limitations: Named provenance exclusion: TOEFL iBT MyBest is rejected, matching Edinburgh. A MyBest composite and a single-administration total can be the same number.

requirement_text: According to IELTS, test results are valid for 2 years. Please note that University Admissions can accept older test results as long as they're available online for verification.
source_authority_note: universityadmissions.se is the official national admissions operator for Swedish higher education, run jointly by the Swedish Council for Higher Education (UHR) and the universities; it is not a .edu/.ac./.gov domain. Needs the APPLICATION_SYSTEM_DOMAINS tier from source-authority-gap.md piece (B), under which it is HIGH authority for platform-wide deadlines, fee structure and central eligibility assessment, and NOT authoritative for programme-specific thresholds.
limitations: A recency rule whose real binding constraint is not age but online verifiability -- the stated 2-year validity is explicitly overridable. Modelling this as a hard max-age constraint would reject scores the operator would accept.
researcher_notes: Sharpens section 2 of scalar-thresholds-are-not-enough.md: a max-age field needs to distinguish a hard bar from a soft default. DTU states the opposite polarity on the same underlying fact -- see REQ-2026-08-22-DK-DTU.

requirement_text: Non-EU/EEA/Swiss citizens should not apply to the second round as there will not be enough time to apply for and receive the required residence permit.
source_authority_note: universityadmissions.se is the official national admissions operator for Swedish higher education, run jointly by the Swedish Council for Higher Education (UHR) and the universities; it is not a .edu/.ac./.gov domain. researcher_notes: Not a formal eligibility bar -- the round is legally open to them -- but an operator instruction that makes the first round the only practical route for non-EU/EEA applicants. Recorded as guidance, not as a hard rule, because the page frames it as 'should not', not 'cannot'.

requirement_text: individuals who are citizens of countries that are not part of the European Union (EU), European Economic Area (EEA, includes Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway) or Switzerland are required to pay application and tuition fees.

requirement_text: The application fee is 900 Swedish kronor.
source_authority_note: universityadmissions.se is the official national admissions operator for Swedish higher education, run jointly by the Swedish Council for Higher Education (UHR) and the universities; it is not a .edu/.ac./.gov domain. researcher_notes: One fee per semester regardless of how many programmes or rounds are applied to. Charged centrally by the national portal, not by KTH or Lund.

requirement_text: Those not required to pay include individuals who: have Swedish citizenship; have been granted a permanent Swedish residence permit; have been granted a temporary Swedish residence permit for reasons other than studies; hold citizenship in an EU or EEA country or Switzerland; are a family member of a citizen of an EU or EEA country and have temporary or permanent right of residence in Sweden; have long-term resident status in Sweden; are a British citizen who started living in Sweden on or before 31 December 2020 (or family member of such a British citizen); are already registered for studies at a Swedish university (exempt from the application fee, but will still need to pay tuition fees); are applying for or are registered for third cycle (doctoral) studies; are registered at a university outside of Sweden and will be studying in Sweden on a temporary basis as part of an official study abroad programme.
